# Font Embedding and Licensing Checklist: Inter text in diagrams and the sharing image

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements for embedding Inter subsets in SVGs and the render script: licensing, completeness, size limits, budget and CSP
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the requirements, not the implementation.

## Licensing and attribution

- [ ] CHK001 Are the Inter licence's (OFL 1.1) redistribution terms for fonts embedded in SVG files stated as concrete obligations, not only "are met"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it specified where the copyright notice and licence text accompany the embedded font data (inside each SVG, or via the site's existing licence file)? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the Reserved Font Name condition addressed for subset fonts that are modified derivatives? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the requirement that embedded glyphs come from the same Inter 4.1 files as feature 018 verifiable (a named source file and version)? [Measurability, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the spec say whether the licence terms apply to the rendered sharing image PNG, and whether any attribution is needed there? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]

## Subset completeness and missing glyphs

- [ ] CHK006 Is "the characters that diagram uses" defined precisely (text content, title/desc, wrapped lines)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003a]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the missing-glyph failure message have a specified format for the character (for example its code point as well as the glyph)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements defined for characters outside printable ASCII such as curly quotes, dashes and ellipses? [Coverage, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it stated how a glyph missing from the subset is detected, rather than assumed absent because the label looks right? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK010 Must the font-family name in the embedded rule match the one in the text styles, with a failure defined for a mismatch? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK011 Are weight requirements (400 and 700 only) consistent with the rule that no italic is embedded, and is the failure for an italic or other weight defined? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "draws any text in a font other than Inter" defined for fallback lists, inherited styles and generic families? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]

## Size and budget

- [ ] CHK013 Is the 16 KB per-diagram ceiling defined as raw or transferred bytes, consistently across spec and plan? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009a]
- [ ] CHK014 Is base64 expansion of the data-URI font accounted for in the 16 KB figure and the "about 4 KB per weight" assumption? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the place where before and after sizes are recorded for each diagram and the story page stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the 150 KB budget requirement stated with its measurement conditions and the pages it covers? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the remedy defined if the diagram growth pushes the story page over 150 KB (no raising, so what instead)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the cache behaviour of the larger diagram file stated, given its fonts are not shared with the page's cached font files? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]

## Content Security Policy and delivery

- [ ] CHK019 Is it stated that the current CSP permits data: font sources for an SVG loaded as an image, and how that is confirmed? [Dependency, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the requirement that the CSP stays unchanged testable (which header or file is compared)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK021 Is an SVG opened directly (outside the page, under its own response headers) covered by the CSP requirement? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the supported browser set named, given data-URI fonts inside image-embedded SVG depend on browser behaviour? [Assumption, Spec §SC-001]

## Tooling and editing path

- [ ] CHK023 Is the fonttools-through-uvx dependency stated as a Principle III decision, with who approves it? [Dependency, Spec Background]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the edit-then-run-script path specified with where it is documented and what the script does on failure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the script's output required to be deterministic, so a repeated run produces no diff? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the render script requirement precise about the face loaded and the absence of any system font name, including fallback lists? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the one-time manual re-render of the sharing PNG reconciled with a unit test that only checks the script, so a stale PNG is detectable? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
